explanation:
# Power and IR report - spi_master (stage: signoff)

All numbers below are copied from reports/power_tool.json (tool: sta 2.6.0 for power per corner; IR block as given). Nothing was re-run by me.

## Power (clk = 50 MHz, input activity 0.2 = 20% toggle rate)

| Corner | Internal (W) | Switching (W) | Leakage (W) | Total (W) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| tt_025C_1v80 | 0.0004153471 | 0.000165638 | 4.652623e-09 | 0.0005809897 |
| ss_100C_1v60 | 0.0003301332 | 0.0001280001 | 4.433962e-06 | 0.0004625672 |
| ff_n40C_1v95 | 0.0004754616 | 0.0001973493 | 8.609129e-09 | 0.0006728195 |

- Highest total power is in the ff_n40C_1v95 corner: 0.0006728195 W. Typical (tt_025C_1v80): 0.0005809897 W.
- The OpenLane flow reports a separate total of 0.0005702339112758636 W. The input data does not say which corner or activity setting that figure uses, so I do not compare it with the per-corner numbers.
- Leakage is much smaller than dynamic power in every corner; it is largest at ss_100C_1v60 (4.433962e-06 W).

## IR drop

- Worst drop: 0.000411 V. Average drop: 0.00011 V.
- Limit: 0.09 V (5% of 1.8 V, A.13 Phase 0 default).
- The worst drop is below the limit, so no PDN change is proposed to Grid. The report does not state the check status of the tool itself; the runtime checks decide pass or fail.

## What this analysis does not cover

- Activity is a flat default 0.2 on inputs, not simulation (VCD/SAIF) activity.
- The IR figures come as a single summary in the input; the voltage source (pad/strap) locations, the analysis corner and the tool used for IR are not given in the data, so they are not stated here.
- Electromigration (EM) is not analyzed by the open flow.
- Dynamic/transient IR (di/dt, decap effects) and package/board inductance are not analyzed.
- The spec lists power targets as out of scope, so there is no power budget to compare against; the numbers are reported only.
- PDK/library (sky130A, sky130_fd_sc_hd) is a DEFAULT pending G1 review.
assumptions: Input switching activity is 0.2 (20% toggle rate, the default), not simulation activity.
Corners evaluated are exactly those in the tool data: tt_025C_1v80, ss_100C_1v60, ff_n40C_1v95.
IR limit is 5% of the 1.8 V supply = 0.09 V (A.13 Phase 0 default), as given in the tool data.
Voltage source locations and the IR analysis corner/tool are not stated in the input data, so no claim is made about them.
Electromigration, dynamic/transient IR and package inductance are not analyzed by the open flow.
PDK sky130A and library sky130_fd_sc_hd are DEFAULT choices pending G1 review.
All numbers are quoted from reports/power_tool.json; no tool was run by me.
open_issues: IR source locations, corner and tool are not documented in the input data; a human should confirm them before signoff.
OpenLane total power (0.0005702339112758636 W) differs from the sta tt total (0.0005809897 W); the cause (tool, activity or corner) is not stated in the data.
Simulation-based activity is not available; 20% default activity may over- or under-estimate real power.
Spec marks power targets out of scope, so there is no power limit to check against.
EM is not checked by the open flow.
